decision.why_not_a: No existing runtime or offline shadow consumer accepts the 8O/8P structured-categorical exfoliation PDA fields directly without a semantic/shape adapter.
decision.why_b: PDA intrinsic information is sufficient for shadow active/identity/overlap use when combined with separately authoritative routine/user context, but an explicit adapter contract is absent.
decision.why_not_c: Legacy strength/count dependencies can remain isolated and unchanged; safe identity-set overlap and context interaction do not require a new potency authority.
